name: St. Peter's Basilica
tagline: Roman Catholic basilica and landmark in Vatican City.

construction.quote: Construction of the present basilica began on 18 April 1506 and was completed on 18 November 1626.

attested_features.quote: The basilica is cruciform in shape, with an elongated nave in the Latin cross form but the early designs were for a centrally planned structure and this is still in evidence in the architecture.
